core_meaning.primary_meaning: Kokab is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Star, celestial body”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kokab corresponds to the Arabic form كوكب (Arabic root ك و ك ب (k-w-k-b); كَوْكَب (Kawkab)). Its core sense is star, celestial body. faq.a: Documented usage records Kokab as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
